hero.description1: My name is Julia, but most people online know me as Zhozabel. I draw comics and illustrations as a hobby, just for fun and love for the process.
hero.description2: I also sometimes write stories, build little worlds of my own, and spend far too much time developing my original characters.
hero.description3: This website is a place to bring all of these interests together — a little home for my comics, art, stories, characters, and whatever else I feel like creating.

character.title: The character
character.name: Kaa-sama (Tsuki Shuuki)
character.description: Kaa-sama is an original character first created in 2020. She is one of the ten members of the Shuuki Clan, who serve the Cyclical Beings.
character.appearance:
Tsuki is one of the ten members of the Shuuki Clan, which serves the Cyclical Beings. She is the medium of the 10th Cyclical Being of the Lower Path, the patron of passion, lust, and carnal pleasures. She is also the mistress of the Moon Temple, located on Moon Island.

Kaa-sama is a beautiful, slender woman with an unusual appearance. She has long, completely colourless white hair, part of which is styled into two large side buns, and red eyes framed by thick, fluffy black eyelashes. Her hair is adorned with numerous golden ornaments. Kaa-sama wears luxurious, layered red garments decorated with symbols of the Cyclical Beings of the Lower Path.
character.personality:
Tsuki is a reserved, calm, and level-headed woman. She is highly self-assured and stubborn, partly due to the power bestowed upon her. Many respect her, while some fear her and even grovel before her.

Despite this, Tsuki is kind-hearted and welcoming towards her adopted daughters. The nuns speak of her as a kind, gentle, and loving person who looks after them and showers them with affection and gifts.

winners.title: Winners
winners.description: Five people evaluated the artworks: four invited judges and the challenge organizer.
winners.scoring: Each judge assigned places from first to third. If an artwork did not make a judge's top three, it received no place. Such entries are represented by null and counted as zero when calculating the average score. The lower the average, the higher the final result.
